rationale: Estimator.setup() (the asv setup hook) calls self.make_scorers(). Estimator is an ABC that does not define make_scorers, and GradientBoostingClassifierBenchmark (ensemble.py) inherits from Estimator and supplies the implementation, so the self call dispatches polymorphically to it. The resolver stops at method_not_on_type on the base class and does not look in subclass overrides. No in-scope rule covers self-dispatch to a subclass implementation.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The prior fp-novel verdict is correct.
